messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then raises her arms overhead and performs a brief dance-like movement before returning to a standing pose.","camera":"A static, eye-level full-body shot from a slightly low angle.","clothing":"A short black dress with off-the-shoulder sleeves, white trim, a white apron-like panel, and a small graphic on the chest, paired with light blue slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Bright yellow-blonde.","hairstyle":"Short blonde hair with a small yellow bun or accessory on top of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, light skin, and a stylized face.","scene":"An outdoor urban rooftop or plaza at dusk, with tiled and wet-looking ground, large gray metal structures, and distant buildings with cranes and neon signs."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original road/underpass environment was replaced with the reference urban rooftop/plaza scene, including tiled and wet-looking ground, gray metal structures, distant buildings, cranes, and dusk lighting. The character remains in the same full-body framing and performs the same standing-to-dance sequence.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the reference rooftop/plaza setting and its lighting while retaining the person's identity, appearance, expression, action, and the existing camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression was fully preserved, since the face is small and stylized in both videos.
unexpected_changes: The character's clothing graphic changed from a skull-like design to a different small chest graphic in the output.
